newsitem.title: USA: BG&E says Md. power unit nears full output.
newsitem.headline: BG&E says Md. power unit nears full output.

text.p: Baltimore Gas and Electric Co said power production was nearly fully restored at its 850 megawatt (MW) Calvert Cliffs nuclear unit 2 after Tropical Storm Josephine caused it to dip late Tuesday.
"It is almost at 100 percent right now," company spokesman Karl Neddenien said Wednesday, adding the unit will reach full power today.
The unit, located in Lusby, Md., was taken down to about 95 percent power to remove seagrass and other debris from the system that was left in the wake of Josephine, he said.
"It just took a few hours," he added.
